title: Beats — one anchor shape, timed to the narration

frames.title: SubInvoker.Apply
frames.explanation: The B1b fixture. Steps 1-4 are judged **with the audio playing** — a beat carrying a `say` fires off the webview's playback clock, so stepping with Next/Previous shows the code and no pulses. Steps 5-7 have no timing at all and fire the moment their audio starts, which is what every pre-beats step did. Step 7 is the **legacy** shape, kept deliberately: a bare `token` with no beats and no line.

steps.ttsText: Apply starts by validating the options it was handed. Then it walks every enabled adjustment in registration order, folding each one into the running total. Finally it guards against a negative result before rounding.

beats.say: Then it walks every enabled adjustment
Finally it guards against a negative

steps.ttsText: The running total is seeded from the amount. Each adjustment in turn replaces it. The value that survives the loop is what gets guarded.

beats.say: Each adjustment in turn replaces it
The value that survives the loop

steps.ttsText: The guard runs last of all. If the total went negative, e.g. because a discount overshot, it is clamped before anything else sees it.

beats.say: The guard runs last of all

steps.ttsText: Rounding is to even at the configured precision scale, which keeps repeated adjustments from drifting upward. The comparison then decides whether a new value is needed at all.
ApplySingle is the one-adjustment path, and it skips the loop entirely.

steps.note: Rounding happens once, at the very end, and only when the guarded amount is not already rounded to the configured scale — so a value that arrives clean is returned untouched rather than being copied through a with-expression that would allocate for nothing.
steps.example: Apply(Money(100.005), options with PrecisionScale = 2) → Money(100.00), never Money(100.01)
steps.ttsText: The last three lines round the guarded total, but only when rounding would actually change it.

steps.ttsText: The seeded total on the first line becomes the guarded one on the second.
